sources: SCMP, The Telegraph India, Inshorts, Newsbytes, Qatar Tribune, Standard Topic, Economic Times, Open Chronicle, Reuters — as reported on 26 November 2026.

stories.headline: Houthis claim strike on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery
stories.summary: Oil climbs more than 1% after the claim. The group also says it hit Jizan Port on the Red Sea coast, causing minor damage and no casualties.

stories.headline: 100th Macy's Thanksgiving parade postponed by storm
stories.summary: New York moves the centenary parade from Thursday to Saturday as heavy rain and strong winds bear down on the city.

stories.headline: Federal court blocks Trump's birthright citizenship order
stories.summary: A judge halts the president's second executive order, after the Supreme Court rejected his first attempt.

stories.headline: FedEx cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport
stories.summary: The MD-11 overshoots Runway 26R, prompting an FAA ground stop and leaving all but one runway closed.

stories.headline: Kim Jong Un vows to expand North Korea's nuclear arsenal
stories.summary: After inspecting nuclear facilities, Kim calls deploying tactical nuclear weapons an "important and urgent task".

stories.headline: Israeli strikes kill nine in Gaza
stories.summary: Among the dead is the Hamas-appointed deputy education minister; a senior Hamas operative is also killed overnight.

stories.headline: Britain calls up 100,000 veterans in biggest drive since the Cold War
stories.summary: Former service members are asked to update their details, in the first large-scale exercise of its kind in decades.

stories.headline: Eight French nationals jailed for life over Islamic State
stories.summary: An Iraqi court sentences the eight for joining the militant group.

stories.headline: Russia hits Kyiv with ballistic missiles
stories.summary: Overnight strikes wound seven; grain ships are also hit near Odesa.

stories.headline: Kroger to cut 3,000 corporate jobs
stories.summary: The US grocer sheds corporate roles over three years to cut costs.

stories.headline: Nearly 300,000 customers lose power in the US
stories.summary: Outages hit households as Thanksgiving travel peaks; utilities race to restore supply.

stories.headline: Hasina's ex-press aide arrested in Bangladesh
stories.summary: KM Shakhawat Moon is held with two others in Dhaka.

stories.headline: Taliban replaces women's names with 'Bibi' in Balkh
stories.summary: Public records must swap women's names for 'Bibi', 'goat' or 'cow'.

stories.headline: Chips and rare earths keep US-China truce fragile
stories.summary: Export controls on both sides strain the tariff pause.

stories.headline: Musk offers two SpaceX shares to every US child
stories.summary: Elon Musk says each child in America will get a stake in SpaceX.

stories.headline: OPEC blames EU for COP31 collapse
stories.summary: The oil cartel points at Brussels after climate talks fail.

stories.headline: US officials split over China spying claims
stories.summary: Intelligence agencies disagree on Beijing's role in the Nvidia affair.

stories.headline: Trump tariffs aim to prise trade from China's grip
stories.summary: Allies are pressed to shift supply chains away from Beijing.

stories.headline: Pakistan unveils Chinese 'trackless tram' in Lahore
stories.summary: The new transit vehicle draws mockery online as a 'bus in vinyl'.

stories.headline: India marks 18 years since the 26/11 Mumbai attacks
stories.summary: The US ambassador pays tribute to the 166 victims, including six Americans.

stories.headline: Memory-chip shortage triples some RAM prices
stories.summary: PC buyers are squeezed as memory costs spike before Black Friday.

stories.headline: FCC clears SpaceX 'Starmind' data-centre satellites
stories.summary: The constellation will host computing in orbit.

stories.headline: New York bans AI chatbots posing as human to children
stories.summary: The state bars bots from pretending to be people in chats with minors.

stories.headline: 40-plus states challenge Character.AI data auction
stories.summary: Attorneys general oppose plans to sell users' chat data.

stories.headline: Salt Typhoon hackers now use AI tool, Microsoft says
stories.summary: Chinese and North Korean groups adopt the ARTEX AI tool for attacks.

stories.headline: EU confirms data theft in EU Academy breach
stories.summary: The Commission says attackers stole data from its training platform.

stories.headline: Fire above Giza tunnel kills 30 in Egypt
stories.summary: Thirty die and 15 are hurt in a blaze above the Ashara Tunnel in Warraq.

stories.headline: Sudan's RSF kills 19 in Blue Nile drone attacks
stories.summary: At least 19 people die in strikes on the Blue Nile state.

stories.headline: Over 20 trapped in flooded illegal gold mine in Indonesia
stories.summary: Rescuers race to reach miners after the pit floods.

stories.headline: North Korea orders Swiss diplomatic office closed
stories.summary: Pyongyang shuts the mission, state media reports.

stories.headline: South African court rules Ramaphosa report unlawful
stories.summary: Judges throw out the report that sought the president's removal.
